title: Geologic map of the Bucksville quadrangle, Horry County, South Carolina
citation: Doar, W.R., III, 2014, Geologic map of the Bucksville quadrangle, Horry County, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-208, map scale 1:24,000.
notes:
Single OCR map sheet with two explanation columns interleaved on the same OCR lines; map face is noise. Symbols legible: Qe, QPsbm; QPps and QPpm inferred from OCR 'Pps' and '@Ppm'; others (moved earth '[me', freshwater marsh 'OHf', Princess Anne '[ Fas', '[ oF pam', Ladson '[ aptas') illegible and omitted. Thicknesses with '|' as first digit (freshwater marsh '| to 50', freshwater marsh and swamp '| to 40', Carolina bay '| to 20', Pamlico muds '| to 15') not recorded. QPsbm lithology after the first phrase is garbled. Bodies of water skipped.
SUBSURFACE: page 1 has no cross section on this sheet; the map face shows SCGS drill hole numbers (OCR '26-158', '26-372', '26-3'); logs are on file at SCGS and not printed. Alloformation margins are given as elevations (Silver Bluff 6-10 ft, Princess Anne 10-18 ft, Pamlico 17-25 ft, Ten Mile Hill 25-35 ft, Ladson 35-57 ft; page 1). Vertical datum not stated; base map uses 1927 North American Datum, contour interval 20 feet.
